pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/LiveWarRoomLeaderboard.tsx:40 The fleet leaderboard prints an ordinal rank over single-scan overall scores sorted with an alphabetical tie-break (computeLeaderboard), with no check against the ±2-point run-to-run noise band the codebase itself measured, so two repos one point apart get distinct ranks that a re-scan can swap.

techniques.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/LiveWarRoomLeaderboard.tsx:40 An order is published with no check that the spread between rows exceeds the within-repo scan wobble (SCORE_NOISE_BAND=2), so draws are shown as ranks. fleetTimetable.ts sorts rows by latest score the same way.

src/features/inflight/live/LiveWarRoomPanels.tsx:151 Movers render through deltaHex/fmtDelta, which mute a within-noise delta to 'held'. A re-scan inside the band reads as a second sample, not a move.

pairs.registryProposal: resolution-precondition's use_when says 'an order over models or prompts or configurations'. Here the candidates are repositories and the LLM-blended scan is the instrument, but the failure is the same: ordinal ranks inside a measured run-to-run SD. The trigger could name 'any ranking produced by an LLM-judged instrument', or the subject could point to peer-benchmarking for it.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/components/leaderboard/LeaderboardTable.tsx:80 The public register gives every model-scored repo a numbered rank by overall score, with no tie at the run-to-run noise band. Its own confidence chip says to treat a low-confidence score as an interval, yet the rank still treats it as a point.

techniques.evidence: src/components/leaderboard/LeaderboardTable.tsx:80 The ordinal rank is published without checking between-row spread against within-repo SD. Rows inside ±2 points are presented as ordered.
src/app/leaderboard/page.tsx:137 Rows scored under an earlier rubric are disclosed above the fold and chipped per row. Mock-engine scans are kept off the ranking.

pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/teamStandings.ts:149 explainTeamStandings always names a leader and a laggard and explains the gap dimension by dimension, even when the spread (line 199) sits inside the scan noise band. A draw is narrated as a standing instead of being reported as a tie.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/org/teamStandings.ts:149 No precondition compares the leader–laggard spread with SCORE_NOISE_BAND before publishing the order. The slug tie-break picks a 'leader' for an exact tie.
src/lib/db/org-insights.ts:301 A period delta inside the noise band goes to a counted 'held' bucket instead of gainers or regressers, so a re-scan wobble is not reported as a move.
